ground_truth.location: SI Table C1, column (5) Sum, Excess Males (Age 15 - 44)
ground_truth.context: SI Appendix C.1, Table C1 ("The Effect of Excess Males on the Probability of Observing at least One Hate Crime"), column (5), the Sum model plotted in main-text Figure 1.  Logistic regression across German municipalities of an indicator equal to one if the municipality saw at least one anti-refugee hate crime (arson or other attacks on refugee housing, or physical attacks on refugees, from the "Mut gegen rechte Gewalt" chronicle of the Amadeu Antonio Foundation and PRO ASYL) over 2015-2017, on Excess Males (the number of men divided by the number of women aged 15-44 in the municipality, 2015), controlling for log population, log population density, log unemployment rate, population change 2011-2015, AfD vote share 2013, and the county-level log refugee inflow (2014-2015), log refugee stock (2014), log general violence per capita, share highly educated, change in manufacturing share (2011-2015) and manufacturing share, plus Male Disadvantage (male over female unemployment rate), with state fixed effects. Municipalities in the top and bottom 2.5 percentiles of Excess Males are excluded.  Standard errors clustered by county.

i4r.notes: Blanket I4R verdict; no per-row entry for Table C1 column 5.

cell.label: claude-code
deviations_manifest: Table 1 control coding is my reading of the paper: age (continuous), gender, years of education, income bracket (factor, 'No answer' kept as a level), occupation factor (used for both main economic activity and employment status; the data hold a single occupation variable), German citizenship, household size and 0-10 self-assessed status (numeric), religion factor and state factor. National battery = the 8 ref_* items, local battery = the 8 ref_loc_* items, entered linearly. Additional controls = contact_ind, distance_ref (factor, incl. Don't know), settle_ref (factor), afd (0-100), afd_ind, lrscale, muslim_ind.
Columns (3)-(6) estimated on one common complete-case sample (only eduyrs has missing values in Wave 4, 11 cases).

SI Table C1 controls use the logged versions supplied in context.dta (population, density, unemployment rate, refugee stock 2014, refugee inflow 2014-15, violent crime per capita) plus d_pop1511_muni, unemp_gendergap_2015, pc_hidegree_all2011, pc_manufacturing_2015, d_manuf1115, vote_afd_2013_muni. State fixed effects (plus year FE in the annual model), as the task states, though the main text mentions county fixed effects. Logit via fixest::feglm, SEs clustered by county.

Extreme Excess Males exclusion: municipalities below the 2.5th or above the 97.5th percentile (R quantile type 7) of the municipality-level distribution of pop_15_44_muni_gendergap_2015 dropped before complete-case selection; the same municipalities are dropped from the annual panel. The Sum outcome = 1 if Hate_all_muni_bin is 1 in any of 2015-2017.
cell.notes: One exploratory run (attempt-1, no RESULT lines) inspected survey.dta and context.dta; the final run is the only run that produced estimates and was not changed afterwards. Table 1 is plain OLS of hate_violence_means on MateComp.cont etc. in Wave 4 (N=3019 for cols 1-2, 3008 for cols 3-6). The C1 models keep only 11 states because vote_afd_2013_muni (and other covariates) are missing for the city-states/other areas; complete-case N = 9282 municipalities (Sum) and 27846 municipality-years (Annual). Read the codebooks codebook_survey.pdf and codebook_context.pdf (documentation inside the mount) for variable definitions only. While reading the paper's method text I saw the Table 1 R2 row and the Job competition entries for cols 3-5, which the redaction left in; I did not tune toward them.
